What is Merchant City of Dorter?

The Merchant City of Dorter , also known as Dorter Trade City, is a location in Final Fantasy Tactics. Located east of the Magick City of Gariland and north of Orbonne Monastery, it is situated a major crossroads in Ivalice. Ramza Beoulve and Delita Heiral first spot Wiegraf Folles here during their battles against the Corpse Brigade, and later Folmarv Tengille hires a group of mercenaries led by Zell in Dorter to stop Ramza from rescuing Princess Ovelia.

Items at the shop near the end of the game: {|class="half-width FFT article-table" style="text-align:center"

This battle is fought in Chapter 1 after the Siedge Weald story battle has been cleared.
